notes: This is only a disabled input-shape template. Actual source/authorization/status/logs must be the original raw files.
When ACK.reused is true, dispatch_records must preserve original response/error and the actual reconciled ACK. Every record is {request:{path,identity},response:{path,identity}}.
Optional source_path denotes the original native path when a byte-exact copy is relocated; its identity is still read and bound.
Neither a request file SHA nor a JavaScript-rounded request_fingerprint substitutes for the daemon request_digest string.
